**STEP 2 – Vessels:** The sushi plate is about 23 cm across (area ≈ 415 cm²); the soup bowl about 15 cm (177 cm²); the fruit bowl about 19 cm (283 cm²). The cups and condiment dish are separate vessels.

**STEP 3 – Items:** Sushi rolls, fresh spring rolls, soup noodles and broth, cut fruit, soy sauce, pickled ginger, tea, and juice.

**STEP 4 – Area:** On the sushi plate, sushi covers about 25% and spring rolls 30% (55% total). In the soup bowl, noodles cover about 20% and broth 55% (75% total). Fruit covers about 60% of its bowl. Condiments and drinks are estimated by their visible amounts.

**STEP 6 – Grams:** Applying bulk density gives approximately 145 g sushi, 145 g spring rolls, 40 g noodles, 190 g broth, and 220 g fruit. Condiments and drinks are estimated at 12 g soy sauce, 15 g ginger, 200 g tea, and 180 g juice.

**STEP 7 – Energy:** Using typical cooked-food values gives about 650 kcal total.

**STEP 8 – Sanity check:** The estimated weight is about 1.15 kg including drinks, with the food portions and energy plausible for the visible multi-dish meal.
